description:
A screenshot utility for capturing, annotating, pinning, and recognizing screen content.


## 中文

- 智能选区支持用鼠标中键直接执行已设置的操作，例如复制或保存截图。
- 完整版可在表格识别、LaTeX 识别及 Markdown、HTML 转换时选择识别模型，并新增「快速翻译」。
- 图片编辑器可在画布上直接查看文字识别结果。贴图在编辑或分割时会保留原始分辨率。
- 跟随鼠标录屏时，取景移动更平滑，并可在录制中看到取景范围。拼图导出 PDF 时可调整图片质量。

## English

- Middle-click a smart selection to run your configured action, such as copying or saving the screenshot.
- Snow Shot lets you choose a model for table and LaTeX recognition and for Markdown and HTML conversion. It also adds Fast Translation.
- View recognized text directly on the image editor canvas. Pinned images keep their original resolution when you edit or split them.
- Mouse-follow recording moves more smoothly and keeps the capture outline visible. You can also adjust image quality when exporting a collage to PDF.

## 下载指南 / Download guide

Snow Shot 完整版包含全部功能。Mini 体积更小，保留截图、标注、贴图、拼图、录屏和手动文字识别。国内用户可在 [Gitee 发布页](https://gitee.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/releases/tag/v1.5.6_snow-shot) 下载同名文件。

Snow Shot includes all features. Mini is smaller and includes screenshots, annotation, pinned images, collages, recording, and manual text recognition.

## macOS 快速安装 / Quick install

复制一条命令到终端。Apple Silicon 用户安装 Mini 时，在命令末尾加上 `--edition mini`。

Copy either command into Terminal. For Mini on Apple Silicon, append `--edition mini`.

